name: Inspector’s Bullhorn
body:
Price 70,000 gp; Slot none; CL 9th; Weight 3 lb.; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This open-ended trumpet of horn bound with gold is mounted with a small handle to make it easy to carry. It amplifies the wielder’s voice, granting all creatures within a 60-foot cone a +10 bonus on Perception checks to hear his voice. The wielder’s voice also becomes a stern voice of authority, granting him a +5 competence bonus on Intimidate checks against creatures in a 60-foot cone when speaking through the bullhorn; this bonus is increased to +10 when making Intimidate checks to temporarily alter a creature’s attitude. If the wielder uses a sonic effect within the 60-foot cone toward which he is pointing the bullhorn, the save DC of the effect is increased by 1, and if it deals sonic damage that damage is increased by 1 point per die.

Three times per day, the wielder can issue a one-word command to creatures within the 60-foot cone, functioning either as greater command (DC 17) or greater forbid action (DC 17), as chosen by the wielder. Alternatively, the wielder can command all creatures within the cone to show themselves; those that fail their Will save cannot attempt Stealth checks on their next turn, and if already hidden reveal themselves, dismissing invisibility, blink, ethereal jaunt, gaseous form, and similar effects. If already visible, they must use a move action to move towards the wielder. Affected creatures can attempt a new saving throw each round at the end of their turn to end this compulsion to reveal themselves. This is a mind-affecting compulsion.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 35,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, fear, greater command, greater forbid action, mass suggestion, shout
